summary: Completed testing of Athlete Profile System (Sistema de Perfil de Atleta). All 14 features tested successfully. Backend: 18/18 tests passed. Frontend: All flows verified via Playwright - login, profile view, tabs navigation, edit profile, search 2026 results, claim results, and race history display.

ui_bugs.issue: Logout button click is intercepted by fixed navigation bar when scrolled to top
ui_bugs.workaround: User can scroll page before clicking logout or logout functionality works via localStorage clear

critical_code_review_comments: All athlete API endpoints use Header(None) for authorization correctly
Login returns specific 'Credenciales incorrectas' error for wrong credentials (not generic error)
Profile API returns full data including nombre, email, telefono, pais, ciudad, email_verified
Search 2026 results queries both archived_participants and participants collections
Claim result updates claimed_by field in source collection and adds to athlete's claimed_results array
Race history correctly includes claimed results with is_claimed flag

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all critical flows work, minor logout z-index issue)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test athlete account
context_for_next_testing_agent: Athlete Profile System fully tested. Test athlete account has claimed result for Hamlet Burgos Frías (BIB #002) from BYSD-2026 race. This result appears in Mi Historial de Carreras. Profile was updated during testing (ciudad: La Romana, contacto_emergencia_nombre: Maria Test).
